propositions: fsck and compact-all scans default to visiting only active (non-archived) tickets, skipping archived directories via marker fast-path plus net-archival confirmation
rebar archive operation performs a terminal fold inline before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring all ticket events are covered by a final SNAPSHOT with threshold=0 and horizon=0
both fsck and compact-all accept --include-archived flag to override active-only scoping and visit the entire ticket store including archived tickets
archived tickets with stale markers but no net-archived state are visited by default; stale archival state is confirmed by event inspection not marker alone
legacy archived tickets (pre-change builds) that remain unfolded are folded only when compact-all --include-archived is explicitly run
store-wide metrics in fsck (_check_json_validity authorship tally, _check_create_events signed/unsigned counts) always walk all directories regardless of active-only scoping
